# Foremerge
> Coordination protocol for coding agents, built above Git. Agents publish
> intent and claim semantic scopes with declared operations before writing
> code; deterministic rules raise findings when plans collide. One Rust
> binary, local-first, Apache-2.0.
## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/naw103/foremerge#readme)
- [MCP setup](https://github.com/naw103/foremerge/blob/main/docs/mcp-setup.md)
- [Conflict detection](https://github.com/naw103/foremerge/blob/main/docs/conflict-detection.md)
- [Limitations](https://github.com/naw103/foremerge/blob/main/docs/limitations.md)
## Install
- `curl -fsSL https://foremerge.com/install.sh | sh` or `cargo install foremerge`
